action: If you use Quorum Cyber or Ontinue, confirm contract terms, contacts and service levels are unchanged during integration.
date_note: Deal was announced on 16 September 2026; this is the closing.
exec: Consolidation among Microsoft-centred managed detection providers; customers of either firm should expect continuity now and a combined portfolio in 2027.
plain: Two security service companies that both focus on Microsoft tools have merged, with Scotland's Quorum Cyber buying Swiss-based Ontinue.
summary: Edinburgh-based Quorum Cyber said it has completed its acquisition of Zurich-based Ontinue, an AI-powered managed security operations provider, following a definitive agreement announced on 16 September 2026. Both Microsoft-focused firms keep their brands for now and plan a unified portfolio in early 2027. Eterna Growth Partners is majority investor in the combined company; terms were not disclosed.
title: Quorum Cyber completes acquisition of managed security firm Ontinue

review.note: Compared 17 Nov completion, Edinburgh/Zurich, 16 Sept agreement, brands kept, unified portfolio early 2027, Eterna majority investor, terms undisclosed against the PR Newswire release.
